why: Krish on the wave-1 animatics: "The Dog's Christmas Shopping List needs a rescript, its just not funny. The others need a lot more humour about them." He wants all four comic modes in rotation ("We'll need all different types of assets if we intend to flood socials, and we'll need to tune the humour"), at "Cheeky, still giftable".
standard: A laugh every 3 to 4 seconds, an escalation to a peak, the picture funny with the sound off, and the real product as the last joke. Voice lines keep heartside's rules: no exclamation marks, no em dashes, the dog speaks as I.

absurd.name: Absurd escalation
absurd.how: Each beat raises the stakes until it is unhinged. The dog treats a tiny problem like a military operation.

meme.name: Meme-text / TikTok voice
meme.how: POV and timestamp formats, on-screen text does the jokes, fast reaction cuts, a comedy sting on every beat.

slapstick.name: Slapstick and visual gags
slapstick.how: The picture is the joke: failed attempts, pratfalls, absurd contraptions, tiny dog versus big world.

deadpan.name: Deadpan and dry wit
deadpan.how: Straight-faced understatement. Nobody admits it is funny. Long holds, flat delivery, a dry button.

scripts.title: Becoming the Mug: The Mug Must Go
scripts.music: The Ingenious into the Fool Me Twice crescendo

beats.picture: Morning. The person sips from a plain mug while scrolling. The dachshund watches from the floor like a jilted lover.
beats.vo: Day four hundred. The mug got another kiss.

beats.picture: The dachshund at a tiny desk in front of a conspiracy board: mug photos, red string, a circled coffee stain.
beats.vo: I've been studying it. It doesn't fetch. It doesn't wag. It just sits there, being hot.
beats.laugh: Picture: the conspiracy board. Voice: 'being hot'.

beats.picture: The dachshund in a tiny hard hat holds a tape measure against the mug.
beats.on_screen: Smiles at mug: 9 / Smiles at me: 0
beats.laugh: Picture and text: the hard hat and the scoreboard.

beats.picture: A flip chart. The dachshund points at it with a pen in its mouth. A basset hound sits in the audience, asleep.
beats.on_screen: Plan A: knock it off the table / Plan B: knock it off the table harder
beats.vo: Plan A was obvious. Plan B was also obvious.
beats.laugh: Text: Plan B. Picture: the sleeping basset.

beats.picture: It flips the page: a crayon drawing of a dachshund inside a mug, with hearts.
beats.on_screen: Plan C
beats.vo: Plan C is unhinged. I love Plan C.
beats.laugh: Picture: the crayon drawing. Voice: 'I love Plan C'.

beats.picture: Run-up across the kitchen, spy music swelling, slow-motion leap into the steam.
The dachshund pops up out of the steam and winks.
The real dachshund mug render, untouched, labelled Example.
beats.on_screen: Plan C: success. / Your dog, in every morning.
beats.vo: The music dips and the chime plays over it.
beats.laugh: Text: 'Plan C: success' pays off the flip chart.

scripts.muted: Works muted: the conspiracy board, the scoreboard, the flip chart and 'Plan C: success' carry it.

scripts.title: Becoming the Mug: Third Time Lucky
scripts.music: The Ingenious, comedy hits on each fail

beats.picture: Ignored at the person's feet. The dachshund narrows its eyes.
Run, leap, and smack: straight into the table leg. It slides down slowly.
beats.on_screen: Attempt 1

beats.picture: It launches off the couch, overshoots completely, and lands in the laundry basket.
beats.on_screen: Attempt 2
beats.vo: Muffled from inside the basket: 'That was practice.'

beats.picture: It builds a ramp from couch cushions, a cereal box and a skateboard. Tongue out, concentrating.
beats.on_screen: Attempt 3

beats.picture: The skateboard rolls, the ramp holds, a slow-motion launch, spy music swelling.
Into the steam. The dog pops up and winks.
The real dachshund mug render, labelled Example.
beats.on_screen: Third time's the charm. / Your dog, in every morning.

scripts.muted: Fully visual: three attempt cards and three pratfalls.

scripts.title: Becoming the Mug: A Formal Complaint
scripts.music: Almost none: room tone, then a short swell

beats.picture: A static wide shot. The dachshund sits perfectly straight, facing camera, like a witness.
beats.vo: I would like to make a formal complaint about the mug.

beats.picture: Still static. The dog blinks once.
beats.vo: It has no fur. It has no personality. It has never once guarded this house.

beats.picture: Cut to the person kissing the rim of the plain mug.
beats.vo: And yet it gets the first smile every single morning.
beats.laugh: Picture: the cutaway to the evidence.

beats.picture: The dachshund now sits on the table next to the mug in the exact same pose, completely still, staring at camera. A long hold.
beats.vo: I am now also a mug.
beats.laugh: Picture: the hold. Voice: 'I am now also a mug'.

beats.picture: The person reaches past the dog for the mug without looking.
beats.laugh: Picture: the person still does not notice.

beats.picture: An off-screen splash. Steam. A wink from the steam.
The real dachshund mug render, labelled Example.
beats.on_screen: Problem solved.

scripts.muted: Captions carry it, and the 'now also a mug' hold works on its own.

scripts.title: Shopping List: Project Nothing

beats.picture: 3 am. The golden in reading glasses at a laptop, a glowing spreadsheet open.
beats.vo: My human said they want nothing for Christmas. Challenge accepted.
beats.laugh: Picture: the reading glasses. Voice: 'Challenge accepted'.

beats.picture: The screen shows a spreadsheet titled GIFT IDEAS.
beats.on_screen: 1. stick / 2. bigger stick / 3. the neighbor's cat
beats.vo: Option three is a long shot, but I believe in it.
beats.laugh: Text: item three. Voice: 'I believe in it'.

beats.picture: A video call. A beagle in a tiny tie is eating the snacks off the desk.
beats.on_screen: Consultant
beats.vo: I brought in a consultant. He ate the budget.
beats.laugh: Picture: the beagle. Voice: 'ate the budget'.

beats.picture: 4 am. A whiteboard covered in paw prints and arrows, three empty water bowls, the golden wild-eyed.
beats.vo: Hour two. I've invented a new color. It's called squirrel.

beats.picture: The golden face-plants onto the keyboard, asleep. The search bar fills with nnnnnnnnnn, then autocompletes.
beats.on_screen: gift so my human thinks about me all day

beats.picture: It jolts awake to the result: the real golden mug render, labelled Example.
beats.vo: Oh. Oh no. It's me, on a mug. They have to look at me every single morning.

beats.picture: The golden spins in a circle, then knocks the consultant off the call.
beats.on_screen: Consultant has left the meeting
beats.vo: You're fired, but in a nice way.

beats.picture: The real golden mug render, labelled Example.
beats.on_screen: This year, the dog's buying.
beats.laugh: The brand line as the button.

scripts.muted: The spreadsheet, the consultant, the whiteboard and 'Consultant has left the meeting' carry it.

scripts.title: Shopping List: I Have Found Nothing
scripts.music: Almost none, then Monsieur Cat Walk at the button

beats.picture: A static shot. The golden sits beside a large empty box, very proud.
beats.vo: My human said they want nothing for Christmas.

beats.picture: The golden nudges the empty box forward with its nose.
beats.vo: So I found them nothing. It was harder than it looks.

beats.picture: The person's feet walk straight past the empty box.
The golden stares at the box, then at camera. A long hold.
The golden at the laptop. The real golden mug render on screen.
beats.vo: New plan. I will give them me.

beats.on_screen: They can't say no. We checked.

scripts.title: Couch Thief: The Operation

beats.picture: A wildlife lens. The golden on the rug, eyes on the person on the couch.
beats.vo: Here, in the living room, the golden retriever waits.

beats.picture: The golden lies beside a tiny scale model of the couch, built from cushions, studying it.
beats.vo: It has built a scale model of the couch.

beats.picture: The golden sits next to a cat who is holding the kitchen door open with one paw.
beats.vo: It has recruited the cat. The cat has demanded payment.
beats.laugh: Picture: the accomplice. Voice: the payment.

beats.picture: The person rises (legs only). The golden instantly places a golden-dog-shaped pillow on the rug where it was lying.
beats.vo: The human rises. The decoy is deployed.

beats.picture: A slow-motion flow onto the couch into the warm spot, the music swelling.
beats.vo: And in one silent movement, the territory is claimed.

beats.picture: The person returns with snacks to find the dog asleep in the spot, the decoy on the rug, the cat eating a snack.
beats.vo: The human will not be getting it back. The human has been offered the decoy.
beats.laugh: Picture: the full tableau. Voice: 'offered the decoy'.

beats.picture: The real golden blanket render, labelled Example.
beats.on_screen: Your dog loves you too. Just not as much as your spot.
beats.vo: Remarkably, it has even put itself on the blanket. The chime plays over the music dip.

scripts.muted: The scale model, the cat accomplice and the decoy tableau carry it.

scripts.title: Couch Thief: Three Attempts
scripts.music: The Call of the Wild, comedy hits

beats.picture: The person leaves the couch. The golden springs.
beats.vo: The golden retriever makes its move.

beats.picture: It leaps, slides across the slippery leather and off the far end, taking all the cushions with it.
beats.vo: An avalanche of cushions. A pause. 'A bold start.'

beats.picture: Second try: it lands in the spot, but the person comes back and sits down on the golden-shaped lump under a plain throw. A head pops out.
beats.laugh: Picture: the person sitting on the dog.

beats.picture: Third try: the golden rolls a ball across the room. The person turns to look. The golden is in the spot before they turn back.
beats.vo: Misdirection. The oldest trick in the forest.

beats.picture: The person on the beanbag, defeated. The golden on the couch, spread out like a starfish.
The real golden blanket render, labelled Example.
beats.on_screen: Your dog loves you too.
beats.vo: Remarkably, it has even put itself on the blanket. Chime.

scripts.title: Couch Thief: Nothing Is Happening
scripts.music: Silence, then a soft swell at the end

beats.picture: A static wide shot of the living room. The person on the couch, the golden on the rug. Nothing moves.
The person gets up and leaves. The golden does not move.
The same static shot. The golden is now on the couch, in exactly the same pose, as if nothing happened.
beats.vo: We did not see it move. Nobody ever does.

beats.picture: The person returns and stares at the golden. The golden stares back. A long hold.
beats.vo: This standoff will last until dinner.

beats.picture: The person sits on the rug.
The real golden blanket render, labelled Example.
beats.on_screen: A compromise.
beats.vo: Remarkably, it has even put itself on the blanket. Chime.

scripts.muted: The jump cut and the standoff work muted.
